name: cli-commands
body: CLI commands: init, start (`--port`, `--no-open`), templates [name]; exit codes and terminal output, including the printed server URL. Shutdown: clean on SIGINT/SIGTERM (macOS) and Ctrl+C / Ctrl+Break (Windows, via os/signal `os.Interrupt`). A clean exit means exit code 0, the port released, and no leftover child processes.
